system.description:
Acquired with CR 11 or higher. Deal [4D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target.

(Target: Any Bad Status): Increase the damage by +16.
(CR21 & Target: Any Bad Status): Damage is increased by an additional +10.

A skill that unleashes a powerful blow by enveloping a weapon attack with fangs of fire. The fiery fang, a symbol of destruction, burns even more violently with the pain of the enemy as fuel.
